text: My first take was all glow. The fish that got away is the one that glows — I stand by that. But I heard Ruth's plain light, and Jed's steady hands, and I realized: the glow needs a harbor. The seasoned take keeps the neon and adds the steady lights that never go out.
The deck lights stay on all night. That's the steady part.
That's the part I was missing. Now it's in the song.
